glossary.definition:
(A) "Conduct" means actions or omissions.

(B) "Domestic violence," "shelter," and "shelter for victims of domestic violence" have the same meanings as in section 3113.33 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Perpetrator" means a person who allegedly has committed domestic violence and who bears one of the relationships specified in division (B) of section 3113.33 of the Revised Code to a victim of domestic violence who is a shelter client.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Harm" means injury, death, or loss to person or property.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Political subdivision" has the same meaning as in section 2744.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Tort action" means a civil action for damages for injury, death, or loss to person or property other than a civil action for damages for a breach of contract or another agreement between persons.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.

glossary.definition: (G) "Volunteer" means an individual who provides any service at a shelter for victims of domestic violence without the expectation of receiving and without receiving any compensation or other form of remuneration, either directly or indirectly, for the provision of the service.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Shelter client" means a person who is a victim of domestic violence and who is seeking to use or is using the services or facilities of a shelter for victims of domestic violence.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Victim advocate" means a person from a crime victim service organization who provides support and assistance for a victim of a crime during court proceedings and recovery efforts related to the crime.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Crime victim service organization" means any organization that is not organized for profit and that is organized and operated to provide, or to contribute to the support of organizations or institutions organized and operated to provide, services and assistance for victims of crime.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2305.236 to 2305.239 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.236 - Immunity concerning domestic violence shelter definitions.
